title: Accounts overview
intro: Accounts is the financial hub for the chart of accounts, journals, ledgers, and statements. Open it from the sidebar when your role includes accounts access.

sections.title: Open Accounts
steps: Sign in with a user that has accounts access.
The screen opens on Chart of accounts by default.
sections.caption: Accounts screen with tab bar and chart of accounts.

sections.title: Tab navigation
sections.intro: Tabs group setup, posting, and reporting. Switching tabs may require manager PIN approval depending on your role.
steps: Scroll the tab bar horizontally when many tabs are visible.
Setup tabs: Chart of accounts and Account groups.
Reporting tabs: General ledger, Trial balance, Balance sheet, and more.
sections.caption: Accounts tab bar.

sections.title: Chart of accounts
steps: Maintain GL accounts used by journals and reports.
Add or edit accounts with codes, names, and types.
Account structure drives ledgers, trial balance, and statements.
sections.caption: Chart of accounts panel.
